effect.fabsbnb.feline_aura.description: Scares attacking phantoms and causes creepers to run away in fear.
enchantment.fabsbnb.capturing.desc: Adds a chance for mobs to drop their spawn eggs.
enchantment.fabsbnb.harvesting.desc: Harvest and replant in an area based on tool tier.
enchantment.fabsbnb.leaf_breaker.desc: Mines the all leaves within range and drops the items at the original block.
enchantment.fabsbnb.ore_miner.desc: Mines the entire ore vein and drops the items at the original block.
enchantment.fabsbnb.scythe.desc: Breaks all the grass and flowers in an area based on tool tier.
enchantment.fabsbnb.tilling.desc: Tills all the soil in an area based on tool tier.
enchantment.fabsbnb.tree_chopper.desc: Mines the entire tree stem and drops the items at the original block.

item.fabsbnb.block_yoinker.desc: Allows you to yoink blocks out of the world and place them somewhere else.

item.fabsbnb.slow_pusher_block.desc: Slowly pushes entities that lands on it in the direction of the arrow.
item.fabsbnb.whoosh_wand.desc: Gives a boost on use. Completely negates fall-damage when the item is held.

text.fabsbnb.block_breaker.desc_screen[2: Has a tool slot in it's inventory. The tool will be used for breaking the blocks. Enchantments on the tool will be applied correctly.
text.fabsbnb.block_breaker.desc_screen[4: The tool will take 1 durability damage for every block it breaks (2 damage if it's the incorrect tool for the block).
text.fabsbnb.block_detector.desc_screen[: Detects blocks placed in front of it.
Outputs a redstone signal if the block matches the set block.
Set the block by placing it in front of the detector and right clicking the detector with a redstone torch.
text.fabsbnb.block_placer.desc_screen[2]: Similar to a dispenser, it has 9 inventory slots. It picks a block out of a random non-empty slot when it receives a redstone signal.
text.fabsbnb.building_wand.desc_screen[0: Building Wands provide a more convenient way to build large structures by allowing the placement of multiple blocks at the same time.
text.fabsbnb.building_wand.desc_screen[2: There are two modes for placement. Normal and Fuzzy.
text.fabsbnb.building_wand.desc_screen[5: Places blocks on top of other blocks of the same type and only if the blocks are all adjacent (diagonals count) to each other.
text.fabsbnb.building_wand.desc_screen[8: Places blocks on top of other blocks where type doesn't matter. Blocks are also placed on all blocks within reach, even if they are not connected.
text.fabsbnb.building_wand.not_enough_bl: Not enough blocks to complete placement.
Not enough blocks in inventory to place.
text.fabsbnb.cactus.desc_screen[1]: Doesn't break when it lands on a cactus block.
text.fabsbnb.cactus.desc_screen[2]: Edible. Giving 2 chunks of food and high saturation. Inflicts weak nausea for 7.5 seconds.
text.fabsbnb.capturing.desc_screen: When a mob is killed with capturing, there's a chance that a spawn egg will drop.
text.fabsbnb.cat_claw.desc_screen: Obtained by using shears on a cat. Ingredient for the Potion of Feline Aura.
text.fabsbnb.detector.info: Right click with a redstone torch when the block you want to target is in front of the detector. Current Target: %s
text.fabsbnb.glistering_melon.desc_scree: Edible. Giving 1.5 chunks of food and high saturation. Applies regeneration for 5 seconds.
text.fabsbnb.harvesting.desc_screen: When right-clicking a crop with a hoe enchanted with harvesting it will harvest all crops within an area base on the tier of the tool.
text.fabsbnb.immune_to_cactus.desc_scree: Items that don't break when they land on a cactus block.
text.fabsbnb.lava_sponge.desc_screen: Like a normal sponge, but for lava. Simply place in lava to remove a large area of lava. Then clear the sponge by placing it in water, a cold biome or dropping it in a cauldron with water.
text.fabsbnb.leaf_breaker.desc_screen: Breaks all leaves within range. Only works on blocks with the #fabsbnb:leaf_breaker_whitelist tag.
text.fabsbnb.lights.desc_screen: A small simple light. Can be waterlogged. Controlled by redstone, turns on when it receives a signal. Powered Light is always on.
text.fabsbnb.name: Fab's Bits & Bobs
text.fabsbnb.ore_miner.desc_screen: Mines the entire ore vein at once. Only works on blocks with the #fabsbnb:ore_miner_whitelist tag.
text.fabsbnb.pusher_plate.desc_screen: Pushes entities that land on the block. The direction is shown by the arrow on top of it. Must be supported underneath. It gets placed facing away from the player in the direction the player is looking.
text.fabsbnb.scythe.desc_screen: When breaking a grass or flower block with a hoe enchanted with scythe it will break all the grass and flowers within an area base on the tier of the tool.
text.fabsbnb.tilling.desc_screen: When right-clicking a dirt type block with a hoe enchanted with tilling it will till all the soil within an area base on the tier of the tool.
text.fabsbnb.tree_chopper.desc_screen: Chops down the entire tree at once. Only works on blocks with the #fabsbnb:tree_chopper_whitelist tag.
text.fabsbnb.whoosh_wand.desc_screen: Alternative to rockets. Gives a boost in the direction you're facing. Gives complete immunity to fall & kinetic damage.
text.fabsbnb.wrench.desc_screen: Used to rotate directional blocks. For example pistons, chests and and logs. Rotates the block clockwise (counter clockwise if sneaking) around the axis of the clicked face.
text.fabsbnb.xp_holder.desc_screen: Holds XP for use later. Right Click to insert 1 level. Shift + Right Click to insert all levels. Left Click to take 1 level. Shift + Left Click to take 10 levels. Retains levels when broken with a pickaxe.
text.fabsbnb.yoinker.desc_screen: Used to yoink blocks out of the world and place them somewhere else. Can for example be used to move chests without having to empty them first.
